description:
Endorses selected skills of a 1st-degree connection, returning each selected skill's name, success and error if it failed. Skill names are in the profile owner's language. Patterns use RE2, are case-insensitive and match anywhere; anchor with ^…$ to match a whole name. Omit skillNamePatterns to endorse all skills; never pass []. An already-endorsed skill counts as success and is never removed. Each success counts toward the stEndorsements limit, including existing endorsements. The limit is checked for each skill; a failure does not stop the others, so check every item's success. If this workflow is still running, do not retry this tool; retrying can count the same skills toward the stEndorsements limit again.

Linked API actions are queued into a cloud-browser workflow and may take several minutes. The server returns immediately after starting the workflow with {status: 'pending'|'running', pendingReason, workflowId, operationName, message}. To retrieve the final result, call get_workflow_result with the returned workflowId and operationName — it will long-poll until completion or the request budget elapses, then return either the final result or another in-progress snapshot. Do not retry the original tool while a workflow is still running; that creates duplicate queued work.

A pending workflow carries pendingReason: 'queued' means it is waiting its turn behind other work on the same account and will start within minutes. 'outsideWorkingHours' means the account has configured working hours and the workflow is parked until they reopen — possibly the next working day. In that case get_workflow_result returns immediately instead of polling, message states when the window opens, and you should report that to the user rather than looping.

personUrl.description: Public or hashed LinkedIn URL of your 1st-degree connection.

skillNamePatterns.description: Optional. 1-20 RE2 patterns, each 1-200 characters, matching names in the profile owner's language. Any matching pattern selects the skill. Matching is case-insensitive and searches anywhere: manage matches Project Management; ^scrum$ matches only the whole name Scrum. Lookaround and backreferences are unsupported. Omit this parameter to endorse all skills; never pass an empty array.

name: endorse_person_skills
